b:
When the whole village gathers
to pull the temple chariot,
and I alone
stay by myself …

my ears can feel
even the sound of the wind

Only the sound of my heartbeat
keeps me company

I am like a child
lost at a festival

There is no one to come looking

The words to speak
hang in mid-air

The full-length mirror
is my only fan

My eyes tell
stories of longing

but I
am formless
before them

One day
the dirges
in my
heart
will find a voice

If not
from love,
let it at least be born
from pity

Until then,
waiting,
I
